name: bollinger_ema_sar_v1_1_robustness
purpose: Relax only the overly restrictive lateral-market slope interpretation while keeping the user's core setup unchanged, then stress the surviving interpretation instead of selecting the highest-return configuration.
core_rules_held_fixed: rocket rejection or body engulfing signal candle
LONG signal low > prior low; SHORT signal high < prior high
EMA3/EMA9 cross on fully closed signal candle
signal close beyond EMA9 in trade direction
stop at low/high of candle immediately before signal candle

slope_interpretations.NET3_SIGN: EMA20 net change over 3 closed bars must have the trade direction; no minimum magnitude.
slope_interpretations.NET3_2PCT_BB: Same direction plus absolute 3-bar EMA20 change >= 2% of current Bollinger bandwidth.
slope_interpretations.NET3_4PCT_BB: Same direction plus absolute 3-bar EMA20 change >= 4% of current Bollinger bandwidth.

promotion_policy.selection_rule: Do not choose the highest-return parameter. Promote every slope interpretation that passes all hard robustness gates; if none pass, promote none.
